  <div id="toast" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 transform translate-y-20 opacity-0 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 bg-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-100 text-white dark:text-slate-900 rounded-xl shadow-xl font-medium text-sm">
    <span class="text-emerald-400 dark:text-emerald-600 text-base">✓</span>
    <span id="toast-msg">Copied release announcement to clipboard!</span>
  </div>

  <script>
    let allPrs = [];

    async function init() {
      await archestra.ready;
      setupEventListeners();
      await fetchReleasePRs();
    }

    function setupEventListeners() {
      document.getElementById('refresh-btn').addEventListener('click', fetchReleasePRs);
      document.getElementById('empty-refresh-btn').addEventListener('click', fetchReleasePRs);
      document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', (e) => filterAndRenderPRs(e.target.value));
      document.getElementById('close-modal-btn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      document.getElementById('close-modal-footer-btn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      document.getElementById('announcement-modal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === document.getElementById('announcement-modal')) closeModal();
      });
      document.getElementById('copy-clipboard-btn').addEventListener('click', copyAnnouncementToClipboard);
    }

    async function fetchReleasePRs() {
      showLoading();
      hideError();
      hideEmpty();
      document.getElementById('pr-grid').classList.add('hidden');

      try {
        const result = await archestra.tools.call('github__search_pull_requests', {
          query: 'is:open is:pr label:"ready-for-release"'
        });

        let items = [];
        if (result) {
          if (Array.isArray(result)) {
            items = result;
          } else if (result.items && Array.isArray(result.items)) {
            items = result.items;
          } else if (result.pull_requests && Array.isArray(result.pull_requests)) {
            items = result.pull_requests;
          } else if (typeof result === 'string') {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(result);
              items = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed.items || parsed.pull_requests || []);
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('Failed to parse string result', e);
            }
          }
        }

        allPrs = items.map(pr => {
          let repoName = pr.repository_name || pr.repo || 'unknown/repo';
          if (!pr.repository_name && pr.html_url) {
            const match = pr.html_url.match(/github\.com\/([^/]+\/[^/]+)\/pull\/\d+/);
            if (match) repoName = match[1];
          }

          let linkedIssues = pr.linked_issues || [];
          if (linkedIssues.length === 0 && pr.body) {
            const issueMatches = pr.body.match(/(?:fix(?:es)?|close[sd]?|resolve[sd]?)?\s*#(\d+)/gi);
            if (issueMatches) {
              linkedIssues = issueMatches.map(m => {
                const numMatch = m.match(/\d+/);
                return { number: numMatch ? numMatch[0] : '', title: m.trim() };
              });
            }
          }

          return {
            id: pr.id || pr.number,
            number: pr.number,
            title: pr.title || 'Untitled PR',
            html_url: pr.html_url || '#',
            state: pr.state || 'open',
            draft: pr.draft || false,
            created_at: pr.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
            repoName: repoName,
            user: {
              login: pr.user?.login || pr.author?.login || 'unknown',
              avatar_url: pr.user?.avatar_url || pr.author?.avatar_url || 'https://github.githubassets.com/images/modules/logos_page/GitHub-Mark.png',
              html_url: pr.user?.html_url || pr.author?.html_url || '#'
            },
            labels: pr.labels || [],
            linkedIssues: linkedIssues,
            body: pr.body || ''
          };
        });

        if (allPrs.length === 0) {
          showEmpty();
        } else {
          renderPRs(allPrs);
          document.getElementById('pr-grid').classList.remove('hidden');
          document.getElementById('pr-count').textContent = 'Showing ' + allPrs.length + ' ready-for-release PR' + (allPrs.length === 1 ? '' : 's');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching PRs:', err);
        if (err && err.code === 'auth_required' && err.url) {
          showAuthError(err.message, err.url);
        } else {
          showError('Failed to fetch pull requests', err.message || 'Please check your GitHub connection and try again.');
        }
      } finally {
        hideLoading();
      }
    }

    function filterAndRenderPRs(query) {
      const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!q) {
        renderPRs(allPrs);
        document.getElementById('pr-count').textContent = 'Showing ' + allPrs.length + ' ready-for-release PR' + (allPrs.length === 1 ? '' : 's');
        return;
      }
      const filtered = allPrs.filter(pr => 
        pr.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        pr.user.login.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        pr.repoName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(pr.number).includes(q)
      );
      renderPRs(filtered);
      document.getElementById('pr-count').textContent = 'Showing ' + filtered.length + ' of ' + allPrs.length + ' PRs';
    }

    function renderPRs(prs) {
      const grid = document.getElementById('pr-grid');
      grid.innerHTML = prs.map(pr => {
        const dateStr = new Date(pr.created_at).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
        
        let statusBadge = '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-md border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800">Ready</span>';
        if (pr.draft) {
          statusBadge = '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">Draft</span>';
        }

        const issuesHtml = pr.linkedIssues && pr.linkedIssues.length > 0 
          ? pr.linkedIssues.map(i => '<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono"><svg class="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2"/></svg>#' + (i.number || i.title) + '</span>').join('')
          : '<span class="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">No linked issues</span>';

        return '<div class="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden group">' +
          '<div class="p-5 flex-1">' +
            '<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">' +
              '<span class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono truncate" title="' + escapeHtml(pr.repoName) + '">' + escapeHtml(pr.repoName) + '</span>' +
              '<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">' +
                statusBadge +
                '<span class="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">#' + pr.number + '</span>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<h3 class="font-semibold text-base mb-3 leading-snug">' +
              '<a href="#" onclick="openExternalUrl(\'' + escapeHtml(pr.html_url) + '\'); return false;" class="hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition">' + escapeHtml(pr.title) + '</a>' +
            '</h3>' +
            '<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">' +
              '<img src="' + escapeHtml(pr.user.avatar_url) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(pr.user.login) + '" class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full ring-1 ring-slate-200 dark:ring-slate-700" />' +
              '<span class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">' + escapeHtml(pr.user.login) + '</span>' +
              '<span class="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">' + dateStr + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60">' +
              '<p class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1.5">Linked Issues:</p>' +
              '<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">' + issuesHtml + '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">' +
            '<a href="#" onclick="openExternalUrl(\'' + escapeHtml(pr.html_url) + '\'); return false;" class="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1">' +
              'View on GitHub' +
              '<svg class="w-3 h-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M10 6H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-4M14 4h6m0 0v6m0-6L10 14"/></svg>' +
            '</a>' +
            '<button onclick="generateAnnouncement(' + pr.id + ')" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer">' +
              '<span>🚀</span> Announcement' +
            '</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';
      }).join('');
    }

    function generateAnnouncement(prId) {
      const pr = allPrs.find(p => p.id === prId || p.number === prId);
      if (!pr) return;

      const announcement = '🚀 *Release Ready:* ' + pr.title + '\\nURL: ' + pr.html_url + '\\nRepo: ' + pr.repoName + '\\nAuthor: ' + pr.user.login;
      
      document.getElementById('announcement-text').value = announcement;
      
      const modal = document.getElementById('announcement-modal');
      const panel = document.getElementById('modal-panel');
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      setTimeout(() => {
        modal.classList.remove('opacity-0');
        panel.classList.remove('scale-95');
        panel.classList.add('scale-100');
      }, 10);
    }

    function closeModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('announcement-modal');
      const panel = document.getElementById('modal-panel');
      modal.classList.add('opacity-0');
      panel.classList.remove('scale-100');
      panel.classList.add('scale-95');
      setTimeout(() => {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
      }, 200);
    }

    async function copyAnnouncementToClipboard() {
      const textarea = document.getElementById('announcement-text');
      textarea.select();
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textarea.value);
        showToast('Copied release announcement to clipboard!');
        closeModal();
      } catch (e) {
        document.execCommand('copy');
        showToast('Copied release announcement to clipboard!');
        closeModal();
      }
    }

    function showToast(msg) {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      document.getElementById('toast-msg').textContent = msg;
      toast.classList.remove('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
      }, 3000);
    }

    function openExternalUrl(url) {
      archestra.ui.openLink(url);
    }

    function showLoading() {
      document.getElementById('loading-state').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function hideLoading() {
      document.getElementById('loading-state').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showAuthError(msg, url) {
      document.getElementById('error-state').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('error-title').textContent = 'GitHub Connection Required';
      document.getElementById('error-msg').textContent = msg;
      document.getElementById('error-action-container').innerHTML = '<button onclick="archestra.ui.openLink(\'' + url + '\')" class="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer">Connect GitHub Server</button>';
    }

    function showError(title, msg) {
      document.getElementById('error-state').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('error-title').textContent = title;
      document.getElementById('error-msg').textContent = msg;
      document.getElementById('error-action-container').innerHTML = '<button onclick="fetchReleasePRs()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer">Try Again</button>';
    }

    function hideError() {
      document.getElementById('error-state').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      document.getElementById('empty-state').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function hideEmpty() {
      document.getElementById('empty-state').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      if (!str) return '';
      return String(str)
        .replace(/&/g, '&')
        .replace(/</g, '<')
        .replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"')
        .replace(/'/g, ''');
    }

    init();
  </script>

Build a responsive single-page Release Dashboard that integrates with my connected GitHub MCP.

## GitHub Integration
- Fetch all open Pull Requests from my connected GitHub repository.
- Only display PRs that have the label `ready-for-release`.
- For each Pull Request, retrieve and display:
  - PR title
  - PR number
  - Author (name and avatar)
  - Repository name
  - Current status
  - Linked GitHub Issues (title and issue number)
  - Creation date
  - Direct link to the Pull Request

## Dashboard UI
- Display each Pull Request as a clean, modern card.
- Include:
  - Title (clickable link to GitHub)
  - Author information
  - Linked issues
  - Status badge
  - Repository name
  - Creation date
  - Primary action button: **Generate Release Announcement**

## Release Announcement Feature
When the user clicks **Generate Release Announcement**:
- Open a clean modal popup containing a formatted Markdown release summary:
  `🚀 *Release Ready:* [Pull Request Title]`
  `URL: [Pull Request URL]`
  `Repo: [Repository Name]`
  `Author: [Author Name]`
- Provide a **Copy to Clipboard** button so the user can paste it anywhere (Slack, Email, Teams).
- Show a success toast when copied.

## Design
- Modern, clean dashboard layout.
- Responsive for desktop and mobile screens.
- Use cards with subtle shadows and rounded corners.
- Colour-code status badges.

I've built the Release Dashboard, a responsive single-page app that connects to your GitHub repository to surface everything ready to ship.

- Fetches open pull requests via the GitHub MCP and automatically filters for the `ready-for-release` label
- Displays each qualifying PR on a clean card complete with author avatars, repository names, creation dates, and status badges
- Surfaces linked GitHub issues right on the card for quick context and traceability
- Generates formatted Markdown release announcements in a modal popup with a single click
- Includes a one-touch **Copy to Clipboard** action with a success toast so you can instantly paste updates into Slack, Email, or Teams

Open the dashboard above to view your ready-to-release pull requests and spin up your next release announcement.
